column2: As befits one called the $$救世主$$...
I can indeed sense within you the strength of will
And surely this child is the $$大邪神$$ who champions $$愛$$...
Perhaps they are the person worthy to wear the armor of $$ガブリエル$$!
I have heard that this child of ours...
came to $$愛$$d you despite your being a $$奴隷$$...
Even though it could bring a charge of any terrible $$大罪$$...
somehow, she came to lavish boundless $$愛$$ on the oppressed...
Though they had lived apart for so long,
perhaps she cannot deny that person's $$血$$ after all...
But if, to bring her back to life, we made her wear this armor of the $$大邪神$$...
But if, to bring him back to life, we made him wear this armor of the $$大邪神$$...
this $$世界$$ would surely be set upon the path to ruin!?
